summary: Backend/integration verification of new 'Rapport' Pro feature for Aufmassprofi. Confirmed all required structures (services, routes, home-screen buttons) are in place. Metro bundler compiles successfully (iOS: 1452 modules, Web: 1018 modules, no errors). Found 2 NEW TypeScript errors in the new feature files due to mismatched property names on the Project interface (snake_case used instead of camelCase). These will not block the bundle but will cause Bauherr name/address to render as empty/undefined in the report edit screen and the PDF. No UI E2E test was performed per the request — user tests on iPhone.

rca_of_issue: Naming mismatch: the Project TypeScript interface in services/LocalStorage.ts uses camelCase for the Bauherr name parts (bauherr_firstName, bauherr_lastName) and 'zip' instead of 'plz' for the postal code (bauherr_zip vs objekt_plz which IS snake_case). The new files app/reports/edit.tsx and services/ReportPdfService.ts incorrectly use snake_case (bauherr_first_name, bauherr_last_name) and 'plz' (bauherr_plz). At runtime TypeScript-erased JS reads undefined for these fields — code silently falls back to project.bauherr_name (combined full name) so user may not notice immediately, but the address will be missing PLZ in PDF. Reproduction: create a project where Bauherr is entered via the structured fields (Vorname/Nachname/PLZ only, no legacy bauherr_name/bauherr_address) and create/preview a Rapport — Bauherr line will be empty or missing PLZ. Mitigation: rename to bauherr_firstName / bauherr_lastName / bauherr_zip (3 sites).
